title: Tea Mist, Monasteries & Colonial Charms
summary: Slow down with gentle high-altitude air, artisanal tea tastings with fifth-generation estate managers, private evening prayers at the Temple of the Tooth, and misty walks between colonial planter bungalows.

cover.alt: Colonial tea estate bungalow among misty emerald tea terraces near Hatton

description:
Quiet hill country retreats, historic forest hermitages, exclusive Ceylon single-estate cuppings, and cool mountain breezes. This is an alpine passage focusing on historic bungalows, private cupping masterclasses, and temple meditation.

We stay two nights in each place so the days never feel rushed — Kandy for its temples and gardens, Nuwara Eliya for its high-grown tea and colonial rituals, and Ella for ridge walks and the famous Nine Arches Bridge.

overview.heading: An Alpine Passage Through Ceylon’s Tea Country
overview.quote: Up here the island breathes more slowly. Mist fills the valleys at four o’clock, the kettle goes on, and somewhere below a train whistles on its way to Ella.

days.title: Arrival & the Royal City of Kandy
days.description: From the airport we climb gently to Kandy, with a stop for a late lunch overlooking the river. In the evening, dressed in white, we attend the puja at the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic.

details.label: Attire Prep
details.value: White wraps provided for the temple

days.title: Peradeniya Gardens & a Forest Hermitage Blessing
days.description: A morning among the giant fig trees and orchid houses of Peradeniya, then into the hills above Kandy to a forest hermitage, where a monk offers a quiet blessing and a short guided meditation.

details.label: Curated Highlight
details.value: Private blessing at a forest hermitage

days.title: The Hatton Tea Valley & Lunch in a Planter’s Bungalow
days.description: The scenic road to Nuwara Eliya winds through the Hatton tea valley, where we stop for a long lunch in a heritage planter’s bungalow with views to Adam’s Peak. Late-afternoon arrival in “Little England”.

details.label: Curated Highlight
details.value: Planter’s lunch in the Hatton valley

days.title: Single-Estate Cupping & Colonial Nuwara Eliya
days.description: A morning in the fields and factory of a high-grown estate, finishing with a cupping masterclass. The afternoon is for Gregory Lake, the red-brick post office and high tea on the lawn of a colonial club.

details.label: Masterclass
details.value: Silver Tips to BOP with the tea-maker

days.title: The Observation Train from Nanu Oya to Ella
days.description: Reserved first-class seats for the most beautiful stretch of the hill-country railway, through tunnels, tea estates and cloud forest. Your luggage follows by car, and the evening is spent on your villa terrace above the Ella Gap.

days.title: Little Adam’s Peak, Nine Arches & Ravana Falls
days.description: Sunrise from Little Adam’s Peak, breakfast back at the villa, then the Nine Arches Bridge from a private tea terrace as the blue train crosses. A cooling stop at Ravana Falls in the afternoon.

details.label: Curated Highlight
details.value: Nine Arches from a private tea terrace

days.title: Farewell to the Highlands
days.description: A leisurely breakfast with the valley view, then we descend through Wellawaya to the Southern Expressway and on to the airport — or extend to the south coast or Yala.

details.label: Extension
details.value: Yala safari or Galle Fort nights on request

reviews.title: A gentle week in the clouds
reviews.text: I travelled alone at 68 and wanted a slow, comfortable pace. Every day had one lovely thing in it — a blessing from a forest monk, a tea tasting with a planter whose family had run the estate for five generations, the train to Ella — and plenty of time to rest. Dinesh is kind, punctual and wonderfully well read.

related.title: The Cultural Odyssey
related.summary: Our flagship private journey through Ceylon’s gilded kingdoms: a dawn ascent of Sigiriya before the crowds, the sacred Temple of the Tooth, the scenic tea-country train to Nuwara Eliya and sunset on the ramparts of Galle Fort.

cover.alt: Sigiriya Lion Rock rising above misty jungle canopy at golden hour

related.title: The Grand Ceylon Odyssey
related.summary: The quintessential Ceylon masterpiece. Climb Sigiriya at sunrise before the heat, wander sacred tooth relic temples, traverse the tea mountains on the vintage observation train, and track leopards in Yala.

cover.alt: Tea train crossing the Nine Arch Bridge in Ella in morning light

related.title: Wild Leopards & Untamed Coastlines
related.summary: Immersive expedition for wildlife photographers and conservation enthusiasts. Private trackers, custom open-sided 4x4 safaris, and private coastal yacht charters for sperm and blue whale sightings.

cover.alt: Open-top safari jeep watching a leopard on a granite boulder in Yala
